newsitem.title: FRANCE: S&P confirms SEB short term rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P confirms SEB short term rating.

text.p: Standard & Poors-ADEF agency said on Friday that it had confirmed its short-term T1 rating on the 1.2-billion-franc treasury bill programme of French domestic appliance maker SEB.
S&P said in a statement it was doing so in the wake of SEB's announcement on Thursday that it was set to take the control of Brazilian electrical appliance firm Arno.

It said SEB would do so with little negative impact on its financial situation and that, moreover, the firm was performing successfully in a highly competitive market and continually reinforcing its market position.
SEB shares, which soared on Friday in wake of the Arno news announced after the Paris stock market close on Thursday, were up 8.78 percent at 1,028 francs at 1515 GMT.
